import tripol.animation

show animation.smoothstep(0.5)

import tripol.game
import tripol.canvas
import tripol.animation

w = 96
h = 64
game.window("Animation", w, h)
pixels = canvas.create(w, h)
for i in range(0, 40) {
    frame = animation.frame(i * 25, 250, 4)
    canvas.clear(pixels, 1052688)
    canvas.rectangle(pixels, w, h, 8 + frame * 20, 24, 12, 12, 65535)
    game.present(pixels, w, h)
    game.wait(25)
}
game.close()

import tripol.arrays

values = arrays.make(4, 7)
show arrays.total(values)
copy = ints(4)
assert arrays.copy_into(copy, values)
show copy

import tripol.binary

data = binary.u16_le(4660)
show data
show binary.read_u16_le(data, 0)

import tripol.bits

flags = bits.set(0, 3)
show bits.test(flags, 3)

import tripol.bitset

b = bitset.create(130)
show bitset.add(b, 63)
show bitset.contains(b, 63)
show bitset.count(b)

import tripol.buffer

items = buffer.create()
items = buffer.push(items, 42)
show buffer.values(items)

import tripol.camera

show camera.screen(120, 100, 2)

import tripol.canvas

pixels = canvas.create(4, 4)

import tripol.compression

items = [4, 4, 4, 9]
encoded = compression.rle_encode(items)

import tripol.console

import tripol.convert

import tripol.datetime

import tripol.dictionary

scores = dictionary.create()
assert dictionary.set(scores, "Alice", 100)

import tripol.discord

pixels = [16777215, 0]
show image.flip_x(pixels, 2, 1)

import tripol.game
import tripol.canvas
import tripol.image

w = 64
h = 48
game.window("Flipped image", w, h)
pixels = canvas.create(w, h)
canvas.clear(pixels, 1052688)
canvas.rectangle(pixels, w, h, 4, 8, 20, 32, 16753920)
flipped = image.flip_x(pixels, w, h)
game.present(flipped, w, h)
game.close()

import tripol.json

data = json.pair("name", "Alice")

show 7 > 3 and 3 > 0
show true or false, not true

import tripol.particles

p = particles.create(3)
show particles.count(p)

import tripol.game
import tripol.canvas
import tripol.particles

w = 96
h = 64
game.window("Particles", w, h)
pixels = canvas.create(w, h)
p = particles.create(28)
particles.burst(p, 48, 32, 12)
repeat 12 {
    canvas.clear(pixels, 1052688)
    particles.draw(p, pixels, w, h, 0, 0, 16753920)
    game.present(pixels, w, h)
    particles.step(p)
    game.wait(50)
}
game.close()

show physics.overlap(0, 0, 10, 10, 5, 5, 10, 10)

import tripol.game
import tripol.canvas
import tripol.physics

w = 96
h = 64
game.window("Overlap", w, h)
pixels = canvas.create(w, h)
canvas.clear(pixels, 1052688)
color = 65280
if physics.overlap(20, 20, 24, 24, 32, 28, 24, 24) {
    color = 16711680
}
canvas.rectangle(pixels, w, h, 20, 20, 24, 24, 65535)
canvas.rectangle(pixels, w, h, 32, 28, 24, 24, color)
game.present(pixels, w, h)
game.close()
